Outside the auto_ontology/dal/ folder, and excluding test code (every file under a tests/ folder), which functions or methods open a transaction themselves by calling write_transaction directly (e.g. `with write_transaction():`) but never call store() directly anywhere in their own body? Only direct calls count; calls made by helpers they invoke do not. Return their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
